deep_analysis.text: Markets are firmly in risk-off mode, with gold, equities, and Bitcoin all lower while VIX climbs and yields jump, and DXY's rise confirms rather than contradicts the move. Rising US10Y alongside a hawkish Fed narrative is reinforcing broad dollar demand, leaving risk-sensitive currencies like the dollar bloc and sterling under pressure. Oil's sharp decline adds a soft note for commodity-linked currencies, even as copper's flatness tempers the growth-scare narrative slightly. Headlines center on Fed-BoE policy divergence supporting the greenback. The next major risk is the US CPI and PPI release, alongside a cluster of central bank decisions from the ECB, BoE, BoC, and RBNZ within the next day.
